comparison.objective: Replace a failed drive with a spare and send the failed drive to secure destruction.
comparison.physical_skill: Drive identification, removal, replacement insertion, and routing the removed unit to a destination.
comparison.success_condition: Spare installed and failed drive sent to secure destruction; the record provides no latch, placement, or scoring details.
comparison.reason: Drive replacement and disposition are assembly/logistics outcomes, not controlled notch fracture or recovery of millimetre-scale tangs.
